about.lead: We are building a clear path from the first question to a confident decision — without dozens of tabs and conflicting information.
about.mission: To make choosing an education simpler and more informed for every graduate in Kyrgyzstan.
about.whyText: After 11th grade it's hard to know where to start: websites are all different, requirements change, and comparing options is almost impossible. UniKG gathers key information in a single, clear format and helps you ask the right questions.
about.f1Text: Universities and colleges of Kyrgyzstan in a single structure for easy search.
about.f2Text: Helps you understand your options based on your interests, city and budget.
about.f3Text: Real experience from real people — no stars, scores or attempts at an artificial ranking.
about.nextText: Explore options on your own or start a conversation with the AI assistant.
